title: VS Code workspace and extensions
description: Configure a portable VS Code workspace, distinguish user from workspace settings, and verify a minimal set of trusted development extensions.
objectives: Open a project folder and distinguish workspace from user settings
Create shared editor preferences without machine-specific paths
Choose extensions by publisher, maintenance and actual project needs
Test a workspace configuration and identify unsafe settings
rubric: I opened the lab directory as a workspace and reviewed its trust state.
I created shared settings and reviewed the recommended extension publishers.
I ran the starter configuration tests successfully.
